topics.name: DWH Access Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for origin input policy, output schema policy, EXT registration, governed `>` addressing, remote read-only boundaries and AccessCore decisions.

semantics.separation_rule: EXT registration, DWH address resolution, DWH boundary policy and AccessCore authorization remain visibly distinct.
semantics.action_rule: EXT edit, policy edit and remote mutation invoke separate authorized operations.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing remote resources grants no read/write authority beyond already authorized monitor data.
semantics.trace_rule: Each remote access view retains origin, target, schema, policy and authorization refs.
semantics.failure_rule: Denied/unresolved paths are displayed explicitly rather than hidden as successful empty results.

invariants.rule: DWH applies data-boundary policy at the origin and target independently; remote addressing, transport reachability and external registration never substitute for AccessCore authorization.

hard_gates.condition: monitor conflates EXT registration with authorization
